family.description: This entry includes Gp3 from Streptomyces phage phiC31. Gp3 is a recombination directionality factor that interacts directly with the integrase tetramer to activate excision and inhibit integration [[cite:PUB00094660]]. The characteristics of the protein distribution suggest prophage matches in addition to the phage matches.
family.name: Recombination directionality factor-like
